pullRequests.title: Alpha 5.1.1: clarify test artifacts and add SHA256 manifests
pullRequests.head: alpha5-build-clarity
pullRequests.body: Makes test builds unambiguous before desktop acceptance. macOS files now include OS+architecture in their names; Windows installer and portable builds have distinct names; each OS artifact contains a SHA-256 manifest. Documentation now explains why GitHub shows two top-level artifacts and which file to use.

pullRequests.title: Alpha 5.2: save desktop acceptance diagnostics
pullRequests.head: alpha5-acceptance-report
pullRequests.body: Adds a privacy-safe JSON diagnostics export for real desktop acceptance. The report can be saved from the tray, is also exposed through the narrow preload bridge, and deliberately excludes local paths/window titles/screen content. Includes a regression test and acceptance-checklist update.

pullRequests.title: Docs: add canonical project handoff for fresh chats
pullRequests.head: docs-master-handoff-2026-09-18
pullRequests.body: Adds a canonical Mura Companion project handoff with the product North Star, preserved decisions, current Alpha 5.1.1 technical state, character pack, privacy/consent constraints, GitHub/CI/test-build status, known gaps and the recommended next sequence. README now links to the handoff so a new ChatGPT/Codex conversation can start from GitHub instead of this long chat.

pullRequests.title: Alpha 6 candidate: first-run discovery and lived continuity
pullRequests.head: alpha-6-lived-continuity
pullRequests.body:
## Status after the 2026-09-19 audit — keep draft

Reviewed head: `10732445fbb45f5a25957a3fc4d1c99f5573a38f`. Existing 48 tests, 46-file syntax checks and 29 Character Pack references pass on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows. However, Source Audit run [35439904375](https://github.com/chup1runov/Mura-companion/actions/runs/35439904375) reproduces 18 failing desired-behavior assertions with four passing controls on each runner. These are not fixed by green CI.

Reproductions are preserved in [draft audit PR #14](https://github.com/chup1runov/Mura-companion/pull/14), targeting this branch without changing runtime. The complete handoff, code review, evidence status and decisions are preserved by [documentation-only PR #15](https://github.com/chup1runov/Mura-companion/pull/15) on main. Read `docs/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md` and `docs/CODE_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md` from current main when continuing; this branch's older handoff predates the audit.

## Why this work exists

An assistant-led hypothetical walkthrough imagining a user aged 13–18 suggested discoverability and continuity problems. It was NOT an actual youth participant study or measured retention/pricing evidence. The user approved the direction: presence before chat, a discoverable first experience, and real shared history shaping later behavior/Home rather than more random animations.

## Source changes in this candidate

- first-run coach, temporary interaction and labeled radial controls;
- explicit handoff explanation and opt-in geometry prompt;
- first-seven-active-day coarse continuity predicates (not a consecutive streak);
- Home v2 room-first layout and symbolic keepsakes with deliberate detail opening;
- Memory Echo rule layer before generic rare/idle activity;
- version `1.0.0-alpha.6` and PR acceptance packaging.

This describes source additions, not successful physical acceptance. Memory Echo is not semantic file understanding or a learned model of user motives.

## Blocking findings to address

Home bypasses bundle asset resolution; onboarding drop can leave the coach blocking the handoff; startup continuity bypasses Quiet; URL scheme and IPC sender validation are missing; Windows adapter writes the reserved PID variable; forgetting indexed-file traces and corrupt-state recovery are inconsistent. Further relationship, rig gain, surface placement/topology and future-platform issues are documented with reproduction IDs.

No complete macOS or Windows desktop PASS report was supplied. The only physical observation in the chat was the earlier Alpha 5 macOS damaged-app launch warning, still open.

## Build provenance

CI `35437665868` and Test Builds `35437665861` succeeded for this head. Installers use synthetic PR merge checkout `f944aad9367d29feabc3699441b413e2bbf3e795`; that is NOT a merge into main. Unsigned artifacts expire on 2026-10-03. Check live metadata and per-installer hashes; the outer ZIP digest is not a DMG hash.

## Merge gate

Fix priority audit findings with behavior-level regressions, then perform real packaged macOS and Windows acceptance. Preserve geometry opt-in, explicit memory consent, no mandatory screen/mic/cloud, no guilt/streak/absence pressure. Keep this PR draft; do not merge merely to preserve chat context. Alpha 5.2 acceptance closure and Alpha 6 approval are not completed.

pullRequests.title: Audit: snapshot verification and reproducible Alpha 6 defects
pullRequests.head: audit/handoff-2026-09-19
pullRequests.body:
## Purpose
Preserve the reviewed Alpha 6 source at `10732445fbb45f5a25957a3fc4d1c99f5573a38f` without modifying runtime behavior. This is an audit/evidence branch, not a release candidate and not completion of desktop acceptance.

The user requested a whole-repository review and durable GitHub handoff before deleting the chat. `audit/snapshot-review.cjs` adds targeted executable/source probes for gaps missed by the existing tests, and records a hash inventory of every tracked file. Known defects deliberately make Source Audit fail; existing contract CI may still pass.

## Scope
Node logic, mocked Electron/DOM transitions, asset references, privacy boundaries, persistent state, Windows reserved-variable reproduction, and future-platform validation. No native interactive macOS/Finder/Windows desktop acceptance is claimed. No user files, tokens, credentials or full chat transcript are included.

The consolidated product decisions, corrected evidence status, build provenance, remediation order and fresh-chat instructions will live under `docs/` on `main`, linked from `docs/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md`.

discussion.body:
## Audit evidence preserved — 2026-09-19

Runtime is unchanged at `10732445fbb45f5a25957a3fc4d1c99f5573a38f`. Initial Source Audit run `35439904375` executed on Linux/macOS/Windows: the existing 48 tests, 46 JS syntax checks and 29 pack references all passed; the targeted checks produced 4 positive controls PASS and A01–A18 FAIL on each runner. Windows also reproduced `VariableNotWritable` from the adapter's reserved `$pid` assignment.

The initial run's JSON upload excluded the hidden output directory. Upload-only commit `4ee2e2ec48130dd7ec67b836c2ab1514b01b4d33` corrected that. Run [35440127883](https://github.com/chup1runov/Mura-companion/actions/runs/35440127883) now has all three report/inventory artifacts:
- macOS `10583975486`
- Ubuntu `10583935510`
- Windows `10583194975`

Their recorded expiry is 2026-12-18T11:26:44Z. Source Audit remains red because the runtime defects remain open; do not weaken its desired-behavior assertions.

Durable findings, curated machine-readable summary, source/branch identities, product decisions, acceptance status and bootstrap instructions have been merged into main via documentation-only PR #15, commit `454dae8b902f03e98882527d5f9aace4d3f7b534`. Start with `docs/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md`, then `docs/CODE_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md` and `docs/audit/2026-09-19-summary.json`. This prevents dependence on expiring Actions logs or the deleted chat.

No native desktop acceptance, inner installer checksum verification or runtime fixes are claimed by this audit PR.
